name: year-2025-2026
title: A year of building with AI, Oct 2025 to Oct 2026
note: Month anchors are seasonal and recurring (holidays, tax season, semesters, conference weeks) plus a few industry trends of the period; edit them to pin specific releases or news. Arcs are one line per persona per quarter: what they are building then. The simulation quotes neither; it writes from them.

months.season: Late October: Q4 planning, Halloween, the push before the holidays.
events: Coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) are the default way small teams build; MCP is how agents reach tools.

months.season: November: Black Friday and Cyber Monday pricing experiments, Thanksgiving week slow in the US, year-end deals.
events: A wave of new model releases from the big labs before year end; teams compare coding agents on real tickets.

months.season: December: holiday slowdown, App Store review freeze around the holidays, year-end investor updates, next year's budgets.
events: Year-in-review posts; AI spend per user is the number founders are asked for.

months.season: January: new-year planning, CES, new cohorts and semesters start, tax-season prep for US small businesses.
events: Accelerator applications open; students return with new projects.

months.season: February: US tax season in full swing, spring semester, accelerator interviews, Ramadan begins mid-month.
events: Bookkeeping and payments founders are flooded; app usage shifts for Ramadan in Arabic-speaking markets.

months.season: March: demo day season for winter batches, SXSW, end of Q1 numbers, Ramadan ends around the 20th.
events: Pitch rehearsals everywhere; AI-built MVPs face investor diligence questions about tests and data access.

months.season: April: Q2 planning, US tax deadline on the 15th, summer internship hiring.
events: Post-tax-season cleanups; pricing changes land as Q2 starts.

months.season: May: Google I/O and Microsoft Build week bring a burst of developer tools, graduations, finals, summer plans.
events: New developer tooling announcements; student founders decide whether to go full time.

months.season: June: WWDC, end of the academic year, summer slowdown begins, mid-year reviews.
events: iOS changes to plan for; interns start; mid-year metrics reviews.

months.season: July: mid-year, quieter inboxes, vacations, a good month for refactors and paying down debt.
events: Summer usage dips for school products, peaks for travel and food.

months.season: August: back-to-school prep, fall launches planned, model releases pick up again after summer.
events: Teams plan fall onboarding; new model generations change cost per call.

months.season: September: fall semester starts with new club members and projects, conference season, Q3 closes.
events: Campus products see their yearly surge; agencies see new client inquiries.

months.season: October: demo day season, Hacktoberfest, Q4 planning, holiday launch prep.
events: Year-end roadmaps; founders write up what a year of building with AI taught them.
